title: Amazwi Azinikele Eceleni Komprofethi
intro: Ezweni elikude, isithunywa esihle sabhekana nokwenqatshwa okunzima yiziphathimandla zaleso sikhathi. Kodwa indilinga encane yemiphefumulo ezinikele yema eceleni kwale nceku ka-Allah, ilangazelela ukuphendula ubizo lwaphezulu. Ukuqiniseka kwabo okungapheli kwakuzohlukanisa isizwe esinamandla futhi ekugcineni kunqobe amandla okungakholwa.
clues: Sasiyiqembu elincane elizinikele, elihlangene okholweni nasenjongweni.
Sasimi eceleni kwesithunywa esihloniphekile esanqatshwa yiziphathimandla ezinamandla zezwe lakubo.
Lapho lesi sithunywa sibuza, 'Obani abangisekelayo endleleni ka-Allah?' saphendula ngaphandle kokungabaza.
Sicele lesi sithunywa ukuba sifune idili elivela ezulwini ukuze lisilethele isiqinisekiso ezinhliziyweni zethu.
Phakathi kwabantu baleso sikhathi, abanye bakholwa ngesigijimi sethu kanti abanye benqaba ngenkani, kodwa u-Allah waqinisa amakholwa.
Singabantu baseHawwariyyun — abafundi abazinikele baka-Isa, abanqotshwa ngokusekelwa ngu-Allah.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
